head.title: How a program starts
head.lead: A dedicated project lead and QA analyst own your program from the first pilot batch.

steps.label: Days 1-3
steps.title: Scope and guidelines
steps.text: We turn your task spec into written guidelines with edge-case examples and a gold set of 200 items.

steps.label: Days 4-10
steps.title: Pilot batch
steps.text: A calibrated team labels 1,000 to 5,000 items. You review agreement scores and error samples.

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Scale the team
steps.text: We add vetted annotators in groups of 25, each passing a qualification test on your gold set.

steps.label: Ongoing
steps.title: Measure and improve
steps.text: Weekly reports cover throughput, accuracy and guideline changes. Raw audit logs are available on request.

items.q: Can we bring our own labeling tool?
items.a: Yes. Teams work in your platform, in Label Studio or CVAT hosted by us, or in a custom tool we build to your spec.

items.q: How do you vet annotators for expert tasks?
items.a: Each candidate passes a domain test and a paid trial on your gold set. For coding and math we require a relevant degree or verified work history.
Most programs are priced per task or per labeled hour after the pilot sets a baseline. Pilots are billed at cost.
Pilot batches return in 10 days. Production batches follow the service levels agreed in your statement of work.
